_about: Ground truth for the llamaindex-docs skill. Every expected term was checked against the official docs on 2026-09-26 (developers.llamaindex.ai api/read and api/grep). must_include: all terms must appear (case-insensitive). must_include_any: at least one term from each group. expect_skill: whether the llamaindex-docs skill should be invoked. needs_live: the answer is not in docs/research and needs the live docs API.
